purpose: Teach: 微分/散らし/弁明/欺瞞/排泄/捕鯨/抗争/殺戮

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、データの微分解析を強化しろ
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Lean forward on the imperative. No warmth—authority issuing a directive with the confidence that it will be executed. Matter-of-fact pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。販促チラシを散らした効果を検証します
lines.en: Understood. I'll measure the impact of the promotional flyers we distributed.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Nod of acknowledgment. Takes the directive and translates it into actionable steps without hesitation. Respectful but assured in competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不祥事の弁明より誠実な対応をしろ
lines.en: And handle any reputation issues with genuine action, not excuses.
lines.style: Firm, slightly cutting. Eyes level. The word 'genuine' lands with weight. This is a warning dressed as direction—not accusatory, but unmistakable. Moderate pace, no slack.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告の欺瞞表現を厳禁とします
lines.en: Understood. We'll eliminate any misleading claims in our advertising immediately.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Slightly quicker than before—showing he's absorbed the deeper message. No defensiveness, just clarity of commitment. Voice carries quiet assurance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工場の排泄物処理を厳格に管理しろ
lines.en: And tighten controls on waste management at the factory.
lines.style: Flat, categorical. No room for interpretation. The opening attack is direct; pace is unhurried but absolute. This is non-negotiable. Slight pause before 'waste' to let it land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。捕鯨関連の食品事業の動向を注視します
lines.en: Understood. I'm also monitoring developments in our food sector related to those regulations.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate. He's reading between the lines now—understands the stakes. Voice is steady but carries awareness of weight. Precise word choice. No overpromising.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合との抗争を避けて連携の道を探れ
lines.en: Look for partnership opportunities with competitors instead of conflict.
lines.style: Composed, strategic. Measured delivery with a slight emphasis on 'partnership'—showing this is the preferred direction. Cool intelligence underlying the words. Doesn't raise voice to convince.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社会的殺戮事件への支援活動も検討しております
lines.en: Understood. We're also exploring how we can support those initiatives in the community.
lines.style: Respectful, measured. The final line of a meeting—slightly warmer than pure protocol but still professional. Voice carries conviction about the company's broader values. Closing statement, not rushed.
